devtools-n1.text: Type generator. Samples on the left, live output on the right, options below. One merged shape from every sample; missing properties become optional, small repeating text becomes an enum, dates, UUIDs and URLs are detected. Try: the language buttons, Read-only types, Add sample, Copy and Download. Unbuilt: JSON Schema, TypeScript and GraphQL as input (shown as not built yet in the app); the board shows six of the nine languages.

devtools-n2.text: JSON editor. One document behind Tree, Code, Split and Table views, with labelled undo and redo, find with the regex builder, a JSONPath query bar, lock-the-shape validation and a hand-off to the type generator. Try: select rows, Duplicate, Move up, Delete then Undo and Redo, Find for $..mode, Lock current shape. Unbuilt on this board: Split and Table layouts and drag and drop, which exist in the app.

devtools-n3.text: Live activity. Liveline-style chart: eased line, pulsing live dot with momentum in words, value badges, quiet grid, keyboard scrub with a spoken readout and a text summary. The board uses example readings; the app draws only real machine counts and receipt run times, with loading, paused, stale, error and empty states. Try: series chips, Pause, Read now, focus the chart and press the arrow keys, the motion Tweak (off stops the pulse and the easing). Unbuilt: candlestick view and a reference line.
